# Critical paths: a pull request that changes (or renames away) any file matching one of these
# patterns is NEVER auto-merged. It gets the "needs-owner" label and one comment instead.
# The auto-merge workflow reads this file from the BASE branch, so a pull request cannot
# loosen it for itself. Syntax: ** crosses folders, * and ? stay inside one folder, a pattern
# without a slash matches that file name in any folder. Every pattern below is covered by
# scripts/ci/critical-paths.test.mjs. See docs/automation.md.

scripts/ci/**
